scope: Atomic deterministic sampled PI/sensor/finite-inventory EOS episodes on restricted two-circuit thermal assembly

controller.filter: sampled EWMA, initialized to true initial sensor temperature
controller.anti_windup: trial conditional integration against amplitude and discrete slew bounds
controller.gains: fixed, nonnegative Kp/Ki; no tuning or closed-loop stability guarantee

transactions.revision: one per batch, one nested plant revision per tick
transactions.work_budget: remaining RHS/substeps strictly tighten each nested integration transaction
transactions.checkpoint: replay controller recurrence from recorded truths and cross-check nested plant receipt chain

limitations: sampled filter and discrete slew, not a continuous sensor/actuator model
fixed setpoint/gains; no bumpless mode transfer, external-agent protocol or general hybrid events
same-environment exact replay; history hashes do not authenticate measurements
synthetic EOS, restricted hydraulic topology; no target-fluid/phase/plant validation
short eight-case campaign, no general stability/optimality claim
no full repository regression; offline replay inherits scientific dependencies
